A new sensor starts and warms up for 60 minutes. A sensor that is already running moves to Sukrara: only one app can read a Libre 3, so the app that had it (LibreLink, Juggluco) stops getting readings and its alarms stop. To move it back, scan it with that app.

Juggluco is your glucose source now. If it is reading this sensor, stop it first: long-press its icon → Pause app, then App info → Force stop (a paused Juggluco keeps its Bluetooth link to the sensor and gets in the way). After the scan Sukrara switches to reading the sensor directly.

In range is %1$d–%2$d mg/dL; very good (%1$d–%3$d) is the part of it where people without diabetes spend most of the day. Very low and very high are the levels of the LibreView report. Extremely high only changes the colour of the line and the number; the report counts it as very high. The ranges colour the number, the line, the status bar and the time in range everywhere.
Dashed lines across the graph at the levels you pick, besides the range limits. Vertical lines all the way left turns them off; the times under the graph stay. Small graphs space them further apart.
Each widget can have its own window: touch and hold it, then tap Reconfigure.
Ring order, clockwise from the top

Each slot is a time-in-range ring or a number from your doctor\'s report: GMI, average glucose or variability (CV), with a green arc when its goal is met. Slots that don\'t fit are hidden, the last one first. A slot needs data for at least a quarter of its window. Last treatment shows your latest rapid insulin (for 4 h) or carbs (for 3 h): the amount, the time since, and a ring for the time left before alerts come back. It takes the second slot\'s place when there\'s room for only two.
The % of time below, in and above range, and how much time was spent at each level
The distribution covers the same time as the graph; the lines stop short of its dots. Each widget can turn it off on its own.
Each widget\'s own settings stay; reset those from the widget (touch and hold → Reconfigure → Use app settings).
